Subject: Partner-sourced credits for SI accelerator cohort / conditional top-up request
Attachments: Grid_accelerator_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF), usage_projection_q3.csv (CSV)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for taking a look. GridAccelerator is launching a 12-week SI-led accelerator (starts 8/2) focused on enterprise search and retrieval. Our SI partner (CloudForge) will onboard ~20 pilot teams; initial forecasts point to modest consumption but several teams anticipate spikes during indexing and eval weeks.

We’d like to request:
- An initial promotional allocation of 50k token-equivalent credits to cover the pilot ramp (3 months).
- A conditional top-up of up to 100k additional tokens triggered if aggregate weekly utilization exceeds 60% of the initial allocation for two consecutive weeks.
- Trial extension: allow pilot teams to keep trial access for an extra 30 days post-pilot for evaluation.

I've attached a short SOW and our usage projection. Key asks: confirm whether Redwood can approve the conditional top-up without a full contract amendment (we prefer a simple addendum + DocuSign). Also highlight any compliance or region constraints we should be aware of (most participants in US).

Timeline: we need an answer by 7/15 to finalize cohort onboarding. Happy to set a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Claire Huang
Partnerships Lead | GridAccelerator

partners@gridaccelerator.com

Rishi / Marissa —

Reviewed the SOW and usage projection. Proposed approval matrix below:

- Initial promo allocation: 50,000 token-equivalent credits, valid for 90 days from activation.
- Conditional top-up: up to 100,000 additional credits; trigger conditions: aggregate utilization >60% of initial allocation for two consecutive weeks and partner confirms intent to proceed.
- Cap & controls: set a hard cap notification at 80% usage with automated email to ops + partner; top-up requires a manual ops job to instantiate (we can streamline but keep manual authorization for first cohort).
- Billing: mark promo credits as cofunded (no charge to GridAccelerator); if usage exceeds combined promo + top-up, normal billing rates apply.

Legal note: since this is promotional and time-limited, we can proceed with a DocuSign addendum referencing deal HS-2026-7894 instead of a full amendment. I added a brief clause for audit access and data-retention alignment (they are US-based so standard Redwood controls should suffice).

Requests:
1) Rishi — confirm the start/activation date you want us to provision (I recommend 8/2 to align with their onboarding).
2) Marissa — please confirm budget tagging and whether channel finance requires a cost center for the cofund.
3) Aditya — any ops constraints for automating the usage checks (I can create a simple webhook if infra is ok).

If we all agree, I'll attach the finalized addendum and route it to Claire for signature.

-Kimberly
